after verb: A2 [ after verb ] feeling fear, or feeling worry about the possible results of a particular situation
畏懼的，害怕的；擔憂的，發愁的

NONE: A2 used to politely introduce bad news or disagreement
（用來委婉地說出不好的消息或者反對意見）恐怕，很遺憾，對不起，抱歉

example: He was/felt suddenly afraid.
他突然害怕起來／感到恐懼。
I've always been afraid of flying/heights/spiders.
我一直都怕坐飛機／懼高／怕蜘蛛。
She was afraid for her children (= feared that they might be hurt).
她很擔心孩子的安全。
[ + to infinitive ] Don't be afraid to say what you think.
不要害怕說出自己的想法。
[ + (that) ] She was afraid (that) he might be upset if she told him.
她擔心告訴他之後他會不高興。
This is your room - it's rather small, I'm afraid.
這是你的房間——恐怕是小了一點。
I don't agree at all, I'm afraid.
對不起，我完全不能同意。
I'm afraid you've completely misunderstood the question.
恐怕你完全誤解了這個問題。
[ + (that) ] I'm afraid (that) we can't come this evening after all.
很遺憾，我們今天晚上終究還是來不了了。
"Was she impressed with our work?" "I'm afraid not (= no)."
「她讚賞我們的工作嗎？」「恐怕並非如此。」
"Does this mean I've got to leave?" "I'm afraid so." (= Yes.)
「這是不是意味著我必須離開了？」「恐怕是這樣。」

NONE: › If you do something afresh, you deal with it again in a new way.

We agreed to look afresh at her original proposal.
我們同意重新考慮她最初的建議。
